title: Edit: mirror a bracket to make the other hand
prompt: This is the left-hand bracket. I need the right-hand one too: mirror it left-to-right about the YZ plane (X → −X), otherwise in the same place. There's no mirror feature, so do it by editing the sketch, and keep the same features.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid (flipping the arcs' direction matters)
Now on the −X side: from X = −60
… to X = 0, same height (50) and thickness (4)
The M4 hole moved to X = −50 (mirror of +50), same Y
Centroid at X = −22.48, the mirror of +22.48: mirrored, not just shifted (a shift would put it at −37.5)
Centroid height unchanged: the slot and the rounded corner kept their Y positions
A mirror image has the same volume (±0.0001%)
Same faces as before (outline, R8 corner, hole, slot)
Same number of round faces: corner, hole and slot ends
Only the sketch geometry changed; the sketch plane and the extrude are untouched

notes: Context centroid (22.4796, 15.9746): L = [0,60]x[0,15] ∪ [0,15]x[15,50], minus the R8 corner piece (square 8² minus a quarter disc, centroid 8 − 32/3π), the Ø4.5 hole and the obround slot (4.5 x 15 + Ø4.5). Negating x without flipping ccw turns each arc into its 270° complement: the sketch self-intersects or changes.
